ebru.grid: The grid is 7×7. 5 or more ink drops of the same colour next to each other horizontally or vertically form a cluster and pay; the bigger the cluster, the higher the pay tier. Winning clusters dissolve into the water, the ones above fall and the gaps are filled.
ebru.comb: When the chain ends (even with no win) the comb sweeps the board: each row shifts circularly along a sine curve and new clusters can form; at most 3 comb passes per spin. The Master Drop (wild) paints its neighbours in the most frequent colour where it lands. 3 or more Golden Combs trigger 8 free spins (Tulip Marbling); in them every cell that bursts drops a paint-stain multiplier (from ×2 to ×256), the stains shift with the comb, and a cluster passing over them has its pay multiplied by the sum of the stains. The maximum win is 10,000 times the bet.

tarhun.grid: The grid is 6×5. You win when there are 8 or more of the same symbol anywhere on the grid; the more there are, the higher the pay tier. Winning stones shatter, the ones above fall and the gaps are filled; the chain continues until no win remains.
tarhun.stones: Storm Stones (×2–×500) drop in the base game and in free spins. If the chain in the base game ends with a win, the sum of the stones multiplies that spin’s win. 4 or more Lightning Seals trigger 15 free spins; in free spins the stones of every winning spin are added to the kept total multiplier and the win is multiplied by that total. 3 seals add 5 spins. The maximum win is 5,000 times the bet.

cascade.grid: The grid is 6×5. You win when there are 8 or more of the same symbol anywhere on the grid; the more there are, the higher the pay tier. Winning symbols burst, the ones above fall and the gaps are filled with new symbols. The chain continues until no win remains.
cascade.free: 4 or more stars on the grid trigger 10 free spins. In free spins, 3 or more stars add 5 more spins. Multiplier crystals drop only in free spins; when the spin ends, the values of the crystals on the grid are added up and, if that spin’s win is greater than zero, multiplied by this sum. The maximum win is 5,000 times the bet; if it is reached, the round ends immediately.

rules.slotLocal: The result is determined in your browser with local randomness before the spin starts; the animation only plays back that result. Even if you leave the page, the round closes with the determined payout. There is no VRF proof.

crash.play: Choose your amount and start the demo. Cash out manually while the multiplier rises. If the round ends before you do, you lose the demo amount of that round.
crash.local: The local time at the moment you click cash-out is calculated; the last frame on screen does not decide the result. If you leave the page, an unfinished local demo is cancelled.

coinflip.play: Choose heads or tails, enter the demo amount and flip. On a correct guess the gross return is 1.96 times your amount; on a wrong guess the demo amount of that round is lost.
coinflip.local: In the local sample the win probability is 50% and the theoretical house edge is 2%. This is not a running on-chain game or a verified VRF result.
